author: RamSet
releaseNotes: 0.19.11 - Under-the-hood engine update (hapCore 0.10.12): adds TCP keepalive to the accessory connection on Hubitat 2.5.1.145 and newer. For the ecobee this is effectively a no-op — it keeps using the existing self-healing recovery behavior — but it's part of the shared engine and is safe on every firmware (it falls back to the previous connection behavior where keepalive isn't available). Nothing to do. (0.19.10 added the auto-recovery fix for a session that could stay dead until a manual Save.)
tags: Thermostat, ecobee, HomeKit, HAP, Local, Sensor

drivers.name: Ecobee HAP Thermostat
drivers.description: Local controller for an ecobee thermostat over the HomeKit Accessory Protocol (HAP): mode, setpoints, temperature, humidity, operating state, and fan.

drivers.name: Ecobee HAP Remote Sensor
drivers.description: Child device for ecobee remote sensors (temperature, occupancy, motion, battery). Created automatically by the thermostat driver.
